name: print-social-cobalt-cake-product-post-with-starburst
title: Cobalt product post with cream-outlined cake, discount starburst and arc footer
whatItIs: A 4:5 cobalt post with a cut-out cake outlined in cream, a cream starburst '-20%', white hand-drawn motion strokes, a bubble-outlined name 'Cherry Charm' with a caption, and a cream arc at the bottom holding the call to action.
whatItMeans: Simple, appetising and clear; the limited palette feels like a confident brand system.
techniques: Outline the cutout product in a thin cream stroke to make a sticker.
Use a spiky badge for discounts.
Add short scribbled motion lines for energy.
Close with a shallow arc in the secondary colour for the CTA.
bestFor: Any brand with a two-colour system

vocabulary.definition: A curved panel at the bottom holding a call to action.
A design using just two brand colours plus imagery.
